published.source: Shaman PR (rotation audit pass 21: Searing Totem before the pull, gated Lightning Shield recast, no totem recasts in the last 20 s, 2026-10-16)

summary: The Enhancement Level 60 build with 2 points moved from Ancestral Knowledge into Improved Ghost Wolf for utility. It is 4.3 behind Level 60 at 180 s.
rotation: Pre-pull: Lightning Shield at -3 s, Searing Totem at -1.5 s; starting totems Strength of Earth IV, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring at -4 / -3 / -2 s (they run out a few seconds before a 300 s fight ends), no mana cost
Recast Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring when down, with at least 20 s left
Searing Totem when it is down and at least 10 s remain (after the pre-pull one)
Rage of the Farseer on cooldown, waiting for the on-use trinket; Blood Fury lined up with it
Other cooldowns (Sapper, Demonic Rune, Major Mana Potion, Land Mine)
Fire Nova while Clearcasting is up
Flame Shock when its DoT is down
Lightning Bolt at 5 Maelstrom Weapon stacks
Fire Nova while the mana covers 12 a second for the rest of the fight
Lightning Shield when it is down and nothing else is ready (orbs fire at the target on raid damage hits, 2 a minute)
consumes: Windfury Weapon (shaman imbue) + Shadow Oil (main hand)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 32 Strength and 14 crit rating, and 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Improved Ghost Wolf is utility only (A/B 0.0)
Orc lead is mostly Axe Specialization from the synthetic axe; with weapon racials off Windshaper Skyborne leads
Maelstrom Weapon proc rate (2 PPM per point) is an assumption until beta reaches level 34
Elemental Focus trigger set: if Stormstrike can trigger it, Enhancement gets too few Clearcasting procs
Raid damage hits on the shaman (2 a minute, which fires Lightning Shield) are an estimate from boss timers, not measured in logs; the assumptions panel runs 0 and 10
notes: mksettings -spec enh -apl optimized (standards 23: every shaman drops its own party totems; the raid's only totem is a second shaman's Grace of Air, standards 25, the shaman drops Strength of Earth, Windfury Totem and Mana Spring Totem itself).
